name: Piva Lake Zipline (Eko Piva, Pluzine)
description: Longest zipline in ME, 1400m ~50m over Piva reservoir, ~35eur, at the Pluzine swim/kayak stop (fits D7)

name: Njegusi Zipline (Boka Bay)
description: 420m at 980m over Boka Bay ~10-15eur, on the Kotor-Lovcen serpentine, walk-up May-Oct (fits D11)

name: Rakitnica Canyon Canyoning (Konjic)
description: Europe 2nd-deepest canyon; ~62eur from Konjic or tamer Babin Do (fits D6)

name: Diving Centre Aquatica - Mljet NP (Pomena)
description: Only dive base on Mljet, NP wrecks + sea cave Odisejeva spilja, 9 days pre-flight (fits D4)

name: Epidaurum Diving - Cavtat
description: SSI center Cavtat Zal; amphora wreck + reef, deep WWII wrecks cert-only; dive D12 not D13 (fits D12)

name: Budva Diving Center (PADI 5-star)
description: ME only PADI 5-star, boat dives to Sveti Nikola; dive D11 ONLY (~54h pre-flight) (fits D11)

name: Durmitor Horseback Ride
description: Plateau ride from Vrazje Lake (D8 stop) past UNESCO stecci, ~75eur, no experience (fits D8)

name: Zrmanja self-rent kayak (Raftrek)
description: Self-rent kayak on the emerald Zrmanja. Inland Zadar-Split variant only (fits D1 inland)

name: Cerovac Caves (Gracac)
description: Croatia largest cave complex, chill show-cave. Inland Zadar-Split variant only (fits D1 inland)

name: SUP self-rent, Cavtat (Zal beach)
description: Grab-and-go SUP self-rent at Cavtat Zal beach, no guide; mellow D12 option (fits D12)

name: Wake Park Tivat (Solila)
description: Rixen cable wake park in Boka Bay; older reviews ~3.7/5; a playful SWAP not a D11 anchor (fits D11)

name: Quad/Buggy Off-Road (Nevesinje)
description: The one in-corridor ATV near Mostar ~40km E. STRETCH: contact-only pricing, detour (fits D5 stretch)

name: Glamping Bagrem (Lake Jablanica)
description: Lakefront luxury glamping tent on Lake Jablanica ~1km from the Ravna pin — ZERO route penalty vs the current camp. Own terrace, private beach, beach bar, on-site restaurant, free SUP/canoe; ~3.9km/6min from Jablanica centre. The WOW tier without moving the sleep location: wake on the lake, paddle before the drive north.
cost: ~€90-120/night for the 42m² SUNSHINE tent (sleeps 5: 1 double + bunk, fits 4) in June; smaller units from ~€49

name: Pinadria Camping Resort (ex-Baško Polje), Baška Voda
description: The with-a-restaurant + bar camp upgrade that Krvavica lacks — big pine-shaded resort 1km south of Baška Voda, 300m to a pebble beach, on-site restaurant/bar/laundry/tennis, clean sanitary block. Pick this on a night the group wants amenities and a livelier base; Krvavica when they want small/quiet/cheapest.
cost: ~€60-80/night for 4 + car in June (resort pricing, verify by date; rebranded Pinadria 2025)
sources: camping.hr, camping.info, booking.com (Pinadria Camping Resort) — coords verified

name: Villa Royal House (Dubravka, Konavle)
description: The real WOW send-off: gut-renovated 19th-century Dalmatian stone house with a heated rooftop pool, hot tubs, sauna and gym on a quiet hillside in tiny Dubravka with valley-to-sea views. 10/10 from 18 reviews, only ~12km/~20min from Dubrovnik airport for the Jun 28 flight. Rural/scenic = exactly the villa signal. Caveat: sleeps 8, rents whole, and it's the airport not old-town direction.
cost: Whole 8-person villa from ~€410/night — split 4 ways ≈ €100-110pp (above strict tier-3 total, but the send-off splurge candidate)
sources: booking.com/hotel/hr/villa-royal-house; planetofhotels — coords verified vs Sokol Grad cluster
